scope: 현재 21개 page.tsx 경로를 19개 시안으로 대응. /는 /home으로 리다이렉트. 세션 ID 없는 두 경로는 공통 404 제안. API는 독립 화면 없음. 모바일 및 각 경로의 모든 오류/로딩 상태는 이번 세트 범위 밖.
brief:
Create a realistic, production-quality UI mockup for Echo, a Korean user's English speaking practice web app. This is ONE screen of a coherent full-route design set, not competing alternatives. Target dimensions 1440 x 1024 desktop viewport. App content only, no browser chrome, device frame, external captions or route paths on the product UI. Match this SAME visual system across the set:
References 1-3 supply ART DIRECTION ONLY: architectural Swiss editorial clarity, large light/regular grotesk typography, black/white, very fine gray rules, a vivid scarlet accent, calm generous space. Reference 4 supplies APP LAYOUT: restrained left sidebar, wide main working area, subtle white surfaces on near-white canvas. Do not copy BrainBox branding, building photos, marketing hero, contact tab, CRM content or CRM blue. Brand wordmark 'echo.' in charcoal with a scarlet dot. Canvas #FAFAF9, white #FFFFFF, text #202020, secondary #666666, rule #E5E5E3; accent #E51E2A sparingly for one primary action and active navigation. Corners 6-10px, no pill-card overload, no gradients, no dramatic shadows.
Use Inter-like regular Latin typography and Noto Sans KR-like Korean UI. Korean interface labels, real English practice sentences. Body 15-16px, generous leading, title 42-50px normal weight. Sidebar width 216px, thin right divider; wordmark at x32 y40. Standard sidebar: '홈', section '연습', '롤플레잉', '문단 암기', section '내 활동', '학습 기록', '녹음 관리'; subtle current item tint and tiny red marker. Small initials avatar and '학습자' at bottom, no invented settings page, AI chat, subscriptions or features. Main content begins around x272. Quiet top bar with breadcrumb, simple initials avatar upper right. Use spacing and typography first, row rules second, tinted surfaces third. No nested cards. No fake stats, fabricated scores, charts, badges or progress streaks. Present focused workflow with clear hierarchy and only necessary controls. Dates if needed anchored to current date 2026-10-03. Keep text sharp, plausible, readable and unclipped.
The FIFTH reference is the approved-for-consistency home mock from THIS design set (not user approval): precisely reuse its wordmark, sidebar width and font scale, nav icon treatment, horizontal rules and overall visual proportions. Match its layout language.
